2608.28411.title: LongPIBench: A Long-Context Benchmark for Prompt Injection
2608.28411.paper_summary: Prompt injection attacks pose a serious security risk to large language models in real-world applications. However, existing prompt injection benchmarks primarily focus on short-context inputs, leaving the attacks and defenses in long-context settings largely unexplored. This gap leads to a substantial overestimation of the effectiveness of current defenses. In this paper, we bridge the gap by introducing LongPIBench, a long-context benchmark for prompt injection covering 4 realistic application scenarios: paper peer review, resume screening, code review, and email summary. For each scenario, we construct a synthetic dataset and a real-world dataset, with context lengths ranging from thousands to tens of thousands of tokens. The evaluation results on LongPIBench reveal significant vulnerabilities of prompt injection defenses under long-context settings: even simple heuristic prompt injection attacks achieve high success rates and frequently bypass state-of-the-art defenses. We hope LongPIBench can serve as a practical benchmark for systematically evaluating prompt injection defenses in realistic long-context scenarios.
2608.28411.paper_summary_zh: 提示注入攻擊對於大型語言模型在現實應用中構成了嚴重的安全風險。<lb/>然而，現有的提示注入基準主要集中在短上下文輸入上，導致在長上下文環境中的攻擊和防禦大多未被探索。<lb/>這一空白使得目前防禦的有效性被大幅高估。<lb/>在本文中，我們通過引入LongPIBench來填補這一空白，這是一個針對提示注入的長上下文基準，涵蓋了四個現實應用場景：論文同行評審、履歷篩選、代碼審查和電子郵件摘要。<lb/>對於每個場景，我們構建了一個合成數據集和一個真實世界數據集，上下文長度從數千到數萬個標記不等。<lb/>在LongPIBench上的評估結果揭示了提示注入防禦在長上下文環境下的重大脆弱性：即使是簡單的啟發式提示注入攻擊也能達到高成功率，並且經常繞過最先進的防禦。我們希望LongPIBench能夠作為一個實用的基準，系統地評估現實長上下文場景中的提示注入防禦。
